data.title: Senior Growth Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Requisition ID # 25WD92032 About the Role We are searching for a strong Growth-focused Software Engineer to our Product Growth team driving user product adoption, engagement and monetisation for our next-generation, AI-powered architecture design product, Forma. In this role, you will sit at the critical intersection of engineering, product, and business strategy. We operate with a strong commercial bias: we believe that code is a means to an end. Your true measure of success will be the tangible commercial outcomes and user growth you drive. If you are passionate about moving the needle on key business metrics, running rapid experiments, and focusing relentlessly on the end result, this is the perfect role for you. Responsibilities - Drive growth: You will design, build, and deploy experiments aimed at improving user adoption and engagement as well as our early self-serve monetisation experiments. - Execute rapid experimentation: Formulate hypotheses and execute A/B tests at a high velocity. You will build minimum viable features to validate ideas quickly, understanding that many tests will fail, and that this failure is a celebrated and necessary part of the discovery process. - Collaborate cross-functionally: Work seamlessly with Product Managers, Designers, Data Analysts and Marketing to identify growth bottlenecks and brainstorm innovative, high-impact solutions. - Make data-driven decisions: Analyze experiment results and user data to uncover hidden insights. You will constantly ask "Why?" to understand user behaviour and inform your next set of technical and product decisions. - Practice pragmatic engineering: Make smart trade-offs between engineering perfection and speed to market. You will handle edge cases pragmatically, often finding creative solutions that require minimal engineering effort to validate a concept. - Leverage AI to multiply output: Act as an AI-accelerated generalist. You will use modern AI tools to accelerate your workflow, stepping outside traditional engineering boundaries to assist with lightweight product management, data analysis and maybe even design tasks to get experiments live faster. The Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who embodies specific traits that align with our outcome-over-code philosophy. Prior experience in a formal Growth Engineering role is highly desirable, a relentless growth mindset is the absolute prerequisite. - Growth mindset & commercial bias: You care deeply about the business impact of your work. You understand that engineering is a tool to solve user problems and drive revenue. And you have a demonstrated ability to drive the team's work to completion, breaking complex tasks into smaller, actionable pieces. - AI-accelerated generalist: You have a strong bias toward using AI to multiply your output. You are comfortable stepping outside traditional engineering boundaries, using AI tools to assist with lightweight product management and design tasks to get experiments live faster. - Self-starter with infinite curiosity: You are proactive about coming up with your own hypotheses and experiments. You do not wait to be handed a rigid roadmap; you find opportunities in the data and act on them. - Resilient to lost code: You are completely comfortable with the reality of experimentation. You know that a significant portion of the code you write will be discarded if an experiment does not yield the desired results, and you do not let ego get in the way of progress. - Comfortable with unscalable solutions: You understand that early tests might be small, scrappy, and unpolished. You prefer a pragmatic approach to validate an idea in days over spending weeks building a highly scalable but unproven feature. - Product-minded communicator: You possess strong product instincts and can articulate the "why" behind your technical choices to non-technical stakeholders. You thrive in an autonomous culture and enable co-workers through knowledge sharing. - Code all-rounder: Experience with multiple languages and technologies, including modern frontend frameworks, large-scale systems, and cloud computing. Qualifications - Experience with data-driven development, A/B testing methodologies, and iterating based on user behavior data. - Interest in conversion optimization, user journey analysis, and driving impact aligned with our mission. - Experience across modern frontend frameworks, large-scale systems, and cloud computing. - Comfort using modern AI tools to accelerate workflow across engineering, product, and design tasks. Even if you feel you don't check off all the items on the list, we still encourage you to apply. Learn More About Autodesk Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software - from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk - it's at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. When you're an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! Salary transparency Salary is one part of Autodesk's competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate's experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. Belonging We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification. Are you an existing contractor or consultant with Autodesk? Please search for open jobs and apply internally (not on this external site).

data.description:
Description The Network Solutions Architect supports FEMA OCIO Operations and Maintenance services by designing, implementing, managing, and sustaining enterprise network operations across hybrid physical, virtual, on-premises, and multi-cloud environments. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable, secure, and high-performing network services supporting FEMA's enterprise infrastructure, including Network Operations Center (NOC) and Security Operations Center (SOC) environments, data centers, cloud connectivity, and mission-critical IT systems. The Network Solutions Architect provides advanced technical expertise in network engineering, infrastructure modernization, cloud integration, operational resiliency, and disaster recovery readiness to ensure enterprise networks remain available, secure, and compliant with FEMA and DHS standards. This position is located at FEMA HQ in Bluemont, VA. You may be able to adjust and work remotely after a period of time. Primary Duties - Design, implement, and manage enterprise network architectures across physical, virtualized, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud environments. - Support FEMA network operations for fixed and disaster-activated sites, including LAN, WAN, voice, video, satellite, internet, intranet, and telecommunications infrastructure. - Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for enterprise network infrastructure and services. - Monitor network performance, availability, utilization, and service health; identify and implement performance improvements. - Troubleshoot and resolve complex network incidents, outages, connectivity issues, routing problems, and interoperability challenges. - Support event, incident, problem, and change management processes. - Maintain network configurations, technical documentation, network diagrams, baseline standards, and operational records. - Support technology refresh and modernization efforts for network infrastructure and communications systems. - Implement and maintain network security controls, including VPNs, access controls, firewalls, IDS/IPS integration, and secure network configurations. - Support cybersecurity operations through network monitoring, traffic analysis, incident response activities, and audit support. - Ensure compliance with DHS/FEMA security policies, enterprise architecture standards, cybersecurity requirements, and disaster recovery best practices. - Support 24/7 operational requirements during exercises, contingencies, disasters, and emergency response activities. - Collaborate with government stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and program leadership. - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to network operations, automation, cloud connectivity, operational efficiency, and resiliency. Education & Experience Must Have required certifications to be considered: - Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) - Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) - Professional Cloud Solutions Architect certification - Multi-cloud certification or demonstrated certification coverage across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and Microsoft Azure - Bachelor's degree and 12-15 years of relevant experience, or Master's degree and 10-13 years of relevant experience. - Experience managing enterprise network operations within a complex, mission-critical environment. - Experience supporting Network Operations Center (NOC) and Security Operations Center (SOC) functions. - Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise networks across physical, virtualized, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud environments. - Experience with LAN, WAN, VPN, routing, switching, firewalls, cloud networking, network segmentation, load balancing, and secure connectivity. - Experience supporting infrastructure migrations, cloud integration, modernization efforts, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives. - Experience with network monitoring, incident management, problem management, root-cause analysis, and performance optimization. - Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation, network diagrams, operational procedures, and configuration records. - Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, regulatory compliance requirements, intrusion detection, SIEM integration, and secure configuration practices. - Ability to effectively collaborate with government stakeholders, technical teams, security personnel, vendors, and program leadership. - Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance. - Must be able to obtain a DHS EOD. data.description:
The exciting world of scientific research is fueled by people with a passion for solving complex problems. At Cayuse, we are committed to our customers’ success by empowering organizations to conduct globally connected research that advances their impact on science, discovery and society. We build on that commitment with proven, integrated and easy-to-use technology that delivers exceptional value, and world class service and support that accelerates outcomes.

But we are more than just an empowering platform powered by advanced technologies. We are a collaboration of exceptional, highly skilled people with multi-disciplinary expertise, and are building our team to support our ambitious growth plans. Cayuse’s foundational strength comes from our customer and employee focused values and commitment to industry-leading solutions. It’s an exciting time to become a key member of our growing team.

Join our remote-first culture as the Lead Software Engineer, a critical, hands-on role where you will serve as the Primary Architect and technical guide for our core product suite.

You will partner directly with senior leadership to own the technical roadmap, define and develop complex, large-scale software solutions, and drive high-level integration strategy decisions. This role demands technical excellence and leadership, requiring you to contribute high-quality code (50% hands-on) while providing deep mentorship and direction to our teams. You will be the driving force behind adopting modern practices like AI-assisted development and DevSecOps, ensuring our services are resilient, scalable, and delighting our customers.

Key Responsibilities

As the Technical Lead for the Team, you will be the primary architect and hands-on guide for our software solutions. Your focus will be on technical excellence, architectural integrity, and mentoring, rather than people management.

  • Technical Vision & Architecture: Own the technical roadmap for the product suite. Partner with architects to model complex systems, reduce technical debt, and drive high-level integration strategy decisions.
  • Hands-on Development (50%): Lead by example by contributing high-quality code to our most complex SaaS products. You will implement long-term technical solutions and "go deep" to resolve systemic architectural challenges.
  • Engineering Excellence: Drive the adoption of modern industry best practices, including AI-assisted development (e.g., Copilot/Claude), DevSecOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to ensure security and scalability. Own quality through automated testing and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • Technical Mentorship: Provide deep technical guidance and unblock offshore and nearshore teams. You will lead code reviews and design sessions to foster a culture of "getting software done right."
  • Cross-Functional Strategy: Act as the technical bridge between product management, quality engineering, and DevOps. You will translate complex product requirements into actionable, high-performance technical designs.
  • System Ownership: Drive long-term corrective actions for performance and reliability issues, ensuring our services are resilient and "delighting our customers."

Qualifications

  • Core Experience
    • 9+ years of professional experience developing, maintaining, and innovating large-scale, high-availability web applications and services.
    • At least 2 years serving in a hands-on technical lead or principal engineering capacity, driving technical decisions and solutions to completion.
    • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or Mathematics (or equivalent deep technical work experience).
  • Technical Expertise
    • Architecture & Cloud Strategy: Strong, demonstrated understanding and practical application of software design and architecture principles, patterns, and long-term integration strategy decisions.
    • Cloud & Infrastructure: Expert experience with AWS, including cloud architecture, serverless programming, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).1
    • Full-Stack Development: Extensive experience with the Microsoft technology stack, including full-stack development using ASP.NET MVC, .NET Framework, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core, Angular, and Typescript.
    • Data Management: Experience with relational databases (Microsoft SQL Server preferred) and NoSQL databases.
  • Leadership and Communication
    • Demonstrated ability to provide deep technical guidance and mentorship, lead design sessions, and conduct high-quality code reviews.
    • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with proven success in translating complex technical issues and architectural designs to technical, product, and leadership audiences.
    • A strong commitment to driving engineering excellence and adopting modern industry practices, including DevSecOps and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot/Claude).
    • Meticulous attention to detail and a steadfast commitment to producing reliable, resilient software products.


Benefits

  • Competitive Medical Benefits (PPO + HSA available)
  • Vision, Dental, Short-Term Disability fully covered by Cayuse
  • Unlimited PTO + Holidays + Flexible Work Schedule
  • Remote Work Stipend
  • Equal Paid Parental Leave
  • 401k with Employer Matching
  • Quarterly Wellness Reimbursement
  • Remote Work Environment, supporting the Ultimate Employee Experience

Cayuse does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or any Cayuse employees. Cayuse is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

data.description:
About the Client Our client is a global leader in e-commerce and technology, recognized for delivering innovative technology solutions, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making at scale. Their BIM & Digital (BIM&D) function develops digital construction and engineering solutions that enable GES stakeholders to improve quality, compliance, sustainability, risk management, scheduling, and virtual design review. They are seeking a hands-on, technically strong Software Developer to build, integrate, and enhance software products across Amazon PreConnector, AWS, Autodesk platforms, and AI-enabled engineering workflows. Job Title Software Developer Job Summary Our client is seeking a hands-on Software Developer to join the BIM&D technology team and contribute to the development and enhancement of innovative software products. The core focus of this role is full-stack software development, API integration, cloud technologies, and AI-assisted engineering. The successful candidate will design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications and APIs within a microservices architecture. They will work extensively with Amazon PreConnector, integrating AWS and Autodesk Platform Services, developing MCP-based integrations, and leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and Amazon Q Developer to accelerate delivery and improve engineering productivity. The role requires strong experience with React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java Spring Framework, AWS, RESTful APIs, microservices, and Git-based development workflows. Experience with Python, SQL, dbt, or AI/ML integration patterns is also valuable. BIM and digital construction knowledge is beneficial but not a prerequisite, as the team will provide the necessary domain context and training. The ideal candidate is a proactive software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, working with emerging technologies, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and building reliable, scalable solutions in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Software Development & Architecture - Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and APIs using a microservices architecture. - Build high-performance, reliable features for Amazon PreConnector and related BIM&D software products. - Contribute to software architecture decisions and ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and secure. - Troubleshoot technical issues and conduct structured root-cause analysis. AI-Assisted Development - Leverage AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Amazon Q Developer to accelerate feature development. - Use AI-assisted tooling to automate repetitive engineering tasks and improve development productivity. - Explore and apply emerging AI development practices to improve code quality and delivery efficiency. MCP & AI Agent Integration - Work with Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations within Amazon PreConnector. - Enable AI agents to interact with AWS data services and internal business intelligence systems. - Support the development and integration of MCP-based solutions for external APIs and enterprise data systems. - Contribute to agentic AI workflows and AI/ML integration patterns where applicable. AWS & Amazon Platform Integration - Develop and maintain integrations with AWS services including EC2, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and Amazon Redshift. - Work with AWS data lakes and Amazon internal data and reporting platforms. - Enable secure data exchange and data democratization across GES stakeholders. - Support real-time reporting and analytics capabilities across BIM&D products. API Design & Development - Architect, build, test, and document secure RESTful APIs. - Integrate Autodesk Construction Cloud, Autodesk Platform Services, AWS services, and Amazon internal platforms. - Follow OpenAPI standards and applicable Amazon security and engineering policies. - Ensure APIs are scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable. User Interface & Experience - Develop intuitive and accessible front-end interfaces for BIM and digital construction applications using React.js. - Apply user-centred design principles to create effective user experiences. - Maintain consistency with established Amazon design systems and engineering standards. Performance & Reliability - Identify performance bottlenecks across applications, APIs, and data pipelines. - Implement solutions to improve throughput, reduce latency, and enhance system reliability. - Monitor and continuously improve application performance at scale. Testing & Quality Assurance - Develop and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end automated tests. - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. - Ensure software meets required reliability, security, quality, and compliance standards. - Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices. Documentation & Knowledge Management - Produce and maintain clear technical documentation covering software, APIs, architecture, and integration patterns. - Document development standards and technical solutions to support knowledge sharing across the BIM&D team. - Contribute to effective technical knowledge transfer across engineering and business stakeholders. Cross-functional Collaboration - Collaborate with BIM specialists, GES engineers, data scientists, product managers, and Amazon technology teams. - Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions. - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Platform Maintenance & Continuous Improvement - Maintain and enhance existing Amazon PreConnector modules and ACC/BIM360 integrations. - Support technology solutions serving GES functions including Quality, Compliance, Sustainability, Risk Management, Scheduling, and Virtual Design Review. - Identify opportunities to improve existing processes, systems, integrations, and engineering workflows. Basic Qualifications - Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. - 3–4 years of professional software development experience. - 2–3 years of hands-on experience with React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), and Java Spring Framework for full-stack web application development. - 1–2 years of practical experience designing and developing microservices-based architectures and distributed systems. - 1–2 years of experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), including services such as EC2, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and Amazon Redshift. - Experience or exposure to CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, or equivalent tools. - 1+ year of experience with Git and collaborative development workflows, including pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies. - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications - Familiarity with Autodesk Platform Services (APS) APIs, including Model Derivative, Data Management, Design Automation, and Viewer APIs. - Awareness of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) and/or BIM360 platforms. - Understanding of BIM principles and industry standards such as ISO 19650. - Familiarity with BIM authoring tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, or Navisworks. - Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. - Familiarity with agentic workflow design, prompt engineering, or AI/ML integration patterns. - Experience integrating with Amazon internal platforms, AWS data lakes, Redshift, BI, or reporting systems. - Experience with Python, TypeScript, C#/.NET, SQL, and dbt. - Experience working with data-intensive applications or construction technology platforms. Software / Programs / Tools - Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, .NET/C#, SQL - Data & Analytics: dbt, Amazon Redshift, AWS data lakes - Frontend: React.js - Backend: Java Spring Framework, REST APIs, Microservices - Cloud: Amazon Web Services (AWS), including EC2, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and Redshift - AI Development: Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, AI/ML integration tools - AI Integration: Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflows - DevOps: Git, CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild - Autodesk: Autodesk Platform Services (APS), Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), BIM360 Job Details - Employment Type: Full-time - Department: BIM & Digital (BIM&D) - Industry: E-commerce / Technology / Digital Construction - Experience Level: Mid-Level - Years of Experience: 3–4 years - Technical Assessment: Yes - Travel Required: No - Priority: High - Work Focus: Software Development, Cloud Integration, APIs, AI-Assisted Development, BIM Technology Note: BIM domain expertise is preferred but not mandatory. The successful candidate will receive relevant domain context and support from the BIM&D team. The primary requirement is strong hands-on software development capability combined with the ability to learn and work across cloud, API, Autodesk, and AI-enabled technologies.

data.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote US

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Backend, to solve complex problems gracefully, grow scalable systems, and help to shape our technical vision. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll take an active role in breaking down projects into tasks, as well as the implementation methods used. We are solving a wide range of technical challenges as we power a leading fashion marketplace.

This is an opportunity to join a team of smart, thoughtful engineers with a clean, robust tech stack. We are organized into cross-functional squads, where you’ll get to use some skills you already know, learn new ones, and help take the team to the next level. We are community driven, and supporting our sellers is critical as our marketplace continues to grow and thrive.

In this role, you will:

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to build features and improvements
  • Extend our API and back-end systems
  • Interface directly with our PostgreSQL cluster
  • Add to and improve our testing environment
  • Solve challenges in architecture, security, anti-fraud, performance, scalability, personalization, optimization, payments and more
  • Be a helpful and supportive presence on the team, contributing to code reviews and other team processes
  • Keep up with the latest development trends in server-side technologies
  • Mentor and sponsor other engineers in your areas of expertise
  • Coordinate and communicate seamlessly across other technical and product teams
  • Be part of an on-call rotation
  • Use LLMs, when appropriate, to improve the product and development workflows

We are looking for:

  • 4+ years of engineering experience.
  • Experience building, maintaining, or architecting one or more production web applications.
  • Knowledge of and opinions on API design, database design, naming, and simplifying complex services.
  • Understanding of operational concerns such as deployment, migrations, configuration, and provisioning.
  • Professional experience with the technologies with which we work (Ruby on Rails with Sorbet, PostgreSQL, AWS).
GOAT Group uses geographic pay tiers based on the employee’s home state to align compensation with market differences across the U.S.

Hiring Range:
Tier 1 (Includes states such as California, New York (including New York City), Washington, Illinois and other higher-cost markets)
$146,800 - $183,400 USD

Tier 2 - (Includes mid-cost markets across the U.S.)
$132,200 - $165,200 USD

Tier 3 - (All other U.S. locations)
$124,800 - $156,000 USD

The hiring range for this position is below, plus benefits (401K, paid time off, dental, medical, vision, disability, life insurance options). To determine starting pay within the hiring range, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, role/level, a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. You may reach out to a recruiter for additional information.

Hiring Range:
$124,800—$183,400 USD

GOAT Group represents the leading platforms for authentic sneakers, apparel and accessories. Operating four distinct brands–GOAT, Flight Club, Grailed and alias–GOAT Group has a global community of more than 60 million members across 170 countries.

Founded in 2013, Grailed is the leading community-driven marketplace for rare luxury, streetwear and vintage fashion. The marketplace was built for enthusiasts, by enthusiasts, and features products from brands including Supreme, Raf Simons, Gucci, Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, Prada and more. With a highly curated selection of resale pieces including inventory exclusive to the platform, Grailed makes fashion accessible.

The company is backed by strategic investor Foot Locker, Inc. as well as some of the leading names in venture capital including Park West Asset Management, T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc., Franklin Templeton, Adage Capital Management, Ulysses Management, D1 Capital Partners, Accel, Andreessen Horowitz, Index Ventures, Matrix Partners, Upfront Ventures, Webb Investment Network and Y Combinator.

GOAT Group will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, if applicable. By applying, you authorize GOAT Group to send you text messages regarding your job application, interview and/or onboarding process, and other job opportunities at GOAT Group. If you are a California resident, please review our California Privacy Rights Notice for Job Applicants. If you are an EU or UK resident, please review our EU / UK Candidate & Employee Privacy Notice.

data.description:
About the Role A fast-growing productivity SaaS startup is looking for a Head of Backend to lead and scale its backend engineering function. You'll join a small, highly capable development team and play a pivotal role in consolidating a microservices architecture, driving performance and reliability improvements, and powering new product growth through well-crafted APIs and integrations. This is a hands-on leadership role — you'll both shape engineering direction and write production code every day. What You'll Do - Expand, consolidate, and scale a microservices backend architecture for a high-growth product. - Improve overall backend performance, reliability, and security posture. - Design and develop new REST APIs for both internal and external consumers. - Build and maintain integrations with third-party services and external APIs. - Create internal tooling to streamline development and operations workflows. - Define and contribute to software lifecycle processes and engineering best practices. - Proactively propose innovative features and backend solutions aligned with product goals. - Occasionally engage directly with customers to triage and reproduce bugs. What We're Looking For Required skills & experience: - 11+ years of professional backend development experience (minimum 6 years considered for exceptional profiles). - Strong hands-on proficiency in Go and Node.js; PHP familiarity is a bonus. - Proven experience building and consuming REST APIs with OAuth2 authentication. - Deep experience with distributed systems and microservices architecture. - Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL or other relational databases and caching systems. - Proficiency with Unix-based systems, Docker, and Kubernetes. - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or equivalent). - Experience scaling infrastructure and implementing monitoring and logging solutions. - Strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, and software design. - Proficient with Git version control. - Strong spoken and written English communication skills. Nice to have: - Experience with third-party and external API integrations. - Security hardening background for backend services. - Experience building developer-facing internal tools. The ideal candidate is: a collaborative, security-conscious engineer-leader who sweats the details, cares about user experience at the API level, and brings a flexible, can-do mindset to a small team environment. Compensation & Benefits - Salary: $80,000 – $120,000 USD annually, depending on experience. - Opportunity to shape backend architecture at a critical growth stage (Series A/B equivalent). - Small team with high ownership and direct product impact. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Location This is an on-site position based in Canada. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada without visa sponsorship.

data.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
data.description:
About the Role A small, fast-moving defense tech startup in Austin, TX is hiring a hands-on Senior Robotics Engineer to design the physical control systems powering high-speed interceptor platforms. This is an onsite, mission-critical role sitting at the intersection of control theory, embedded software, and real-world robotics — directly impacting system performance against emerging threats. You'll be a core member of a tight-knit engineering team focused on shipping field-ready capability. What You'll Do - Design and implement physical control systems — the "body" — for interceptor platforms. - Develop high-bandwidth control loops and advanced control algorithms (e.g., PID, model-predictive, adaptive control) to ensure vehicle stability and precise high-speed maneuvers under dynamic load. - Write high-quality, efficient embedded code (primarily Rust, C, or C++) to manage actuators, motor drivers (via CAN bus), and sensors on RTOS. - Integrate and fuse camera and IMU data (e.g., EKF/UKF) on embedded platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson for reliable, real-time state estimation. - Translate computer-vision tracking output into reliable motor commands that steer the interceptor. - Build and maintain Python-based tools for calibration, logging, and CI/CD to support rapid iteration and deployment. - Work fully onsite in Austin, TX as a full-time member of a small, senior engineering team. What We're Looking For Required - 6+ years of relevant experience in robotics, controls, or embedded systems. - Strong control theory fundamentals — expertise in PID, model-predictive or adaptive control, and performance tuning for robotics. - Proficiency in Rust, C, or C++ for embedded, low-latency hardware interaction. - Deep experience with embedded platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson), camera pipelines, IMUs, and sensor fusion techniques (EKF/UKF). - Hands-on knowledge of motor drivers, CAN bus, RTOS, and ROS2/DDS or similar middleware. - End-to-end autonomy development experience: translating computer vision outputs into reliable motor commands. - U.S. citizenship and ability to pass a background check; existing security clearance or ability to obtain one is required. - A demonstrated passion for building robots or engineering projects — in or out of work. Nice to Have - PCB design familiarity and EMC awareness; experience with oscilloscopes, logic/CAN analyzers, and basic rework. - Prior defense startup or mission-driven product experience. - Safety-critical workflow experience. - Model-predictive or adaptive control expertise beyond PID. Compensation & Benefits - Base salary: $150,000 – $250,000 USD annually, commensurate with experience. - Equity participation in an early-stage, high-growth defense tech company. - Comprehensive benefits package. Location This role is fully onsite in Austin, TX. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available. Visa sponsorship is not available — U.S. citizenship is required for security clearance eligibility.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/senior-robotics-engineer-clera

data.title: GTM Engineer
data.description:
About the Role Join a fast-moving, seed-stage AI infrastructure company building the communication and identity layer for AI agents. As a GTM Engineer, you will architect the systems behind the company's growth — owning the data pipeline, outbound engine, and the company-wide source of truth from day one. This is a high-agency, build-and-own role for someone who wants to help invent a market, not just run someone else's playbook. The product is an API-first email infrastructure platform purpose-built for AI agents — enabling them to send, receive, and manage email programmatically. The company is backed by top-tier investors and growing quickly in the developer tools and AI infrastructure space. What You'll Do - Own the growth data layer end to end: instrument the funnel, enrich every signup, and build dashboards that serve as the company's source of truth. - Turn top customers into ten more through lookalike modeling, automated outbound, LinkedIn plays, and surfacing champions inside existing accounts. - Run experiments across the PLG engine — content, integrations, backlinks, paid — and double down on what drives signups. - Connect the GTM stack through APIs, webhooks, and automation so data flows cleanly between analytics platforms, CRMs, enrichment providers, and outbound tooling. - Own tooling decisions: evaluate, adopt, and retire tools as the stack evolves. - Build AI-powered internal tools and ship systems from prototype through rollout, adoption, and governance. What We're Looking For Required - 3+ years of experience as a GTM Engineer, Sales Engineer, or similar customer-facing technical role building and delivering solutions. - Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL, or similar) demonstrated through production code or real projects. - Solid technical foundation in CS, data science, or equivalent — you write real scripts, wire APIs together, and are comfortable with modern AI coding tools. - Hands-on experience designing, instrumenting, and owning a growth data layer and the dashboards that serve as a company's source of truth. - Experience building and maintaining data pipelines that move data between analytics platforms, CRMs, enrichment providers, and outbound tools via APIs and webhooks. - Experience running PLG growth experiments — A/B testing, content, integrations, backlinks, paid channels, and lookalike modeling for outbound. - Ability to ship AI-powered internal tools from prototype through full rollout with adoption and governance. - Experience with API design, REST/GraphQL, or integration patterns. - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and/or containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). - Experience with SQL databases and data querying. - Comfortable with Git and collaborative development workflows. - High agency in ambiguity: you call out what's broken, form an opinion, and fix things without being asked. - Organized enough that the systems you build don't rot — clean data is a discipline, not a feature. - Able to work on-site in San Francisco, Los Angeles, or New York City. Bonus / Nice to Have - Hands-on experience with Clay, n8n, enrichment waterfalls, or email sending infrastructure. - PostHog fluency. - Experience shipping agentic workflows or internal AI tooling. - Background at a technical PLG company. - Experience with infrastructure-as-code or DevOps tooling. - Experience with monitoring, logging, or observability tools. Compensation & Benefits - Salary: $120,000 – $200,000 USD annually, depending on experience. - Early-stage equity in a well-backed company at the ground floor of the AI agent communication market. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Location This is a fully on-site role. Candidates must be willing and able to work in person at one of the following offices: San Francisco, CA · Los Angeles, CA · New York City, NY.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/gtm-engineer-clera

data.title: Head of Engineering
data.description:
About the Role This is a pivotal technical leadership role at an early-stage wearable sensing and robotics startup. As Head of Engineering, you will own the full technical execution of a body-worn sensing platform — from architecture through shipping — while leading a distributed team of specialists across India and San Francisco. You will make consequential design and integration decisions across power systems, sensor synchronization, firmware, and mechanical domains every week, with direct impact on both product quality and underlying model capabilities. This role is based in India (on-site), with regular travel to San Francisco, CA, USA (approximately one week per month). What You'll Do - Own technical execution of a body-worn sensing platform from architecture through production shipping. - Lead and coordinate a distributed team of hardware specialists across India and the US. - Make design and integration decisions across power systems, sensor synchronization, firmware/embedded Linux, and mechanical structure. - Define and maintain the complete hardware system architecture so all subsystems — mechanical, electrical, and firmware — integrate into a coherent wearable product. - Translate product requirements into clear, actionable engineering briefs for the remote team. - Review and critique mechanical designs with engineering justification focused on wearability and durability. - Debug firmware and system issues using schematics, logic analyzers, and serial logs. - Shape hiring criteria and interview processes to grow team capability over time. - Take hands-on ownership of meaningful systems from day one and measure your impact on product and model capabilities. What We're Looking For Dealbreakers — you must have all of the following: - US citizenship or valid US visa (required; no sponsorship available). - 6–10+ years of hardware engineering experience building wearable devices, robotics, motion capture systems, or field-deployed hardware. - Hands-on, first-principles power systems expertise: personally designed a multi-rail battery-powered architecture, can size protection circuits, select regulator topologies, and analyze inrush/brownout behavior on first power-on; comfortable reading and critiquing schematics. - At least one shipped hardware product with a full arc from first prototype to real end users. - Willingness to be based in India and travel to San Francisco approximately once per month. Required skills and experience: - Deep experience solving sensor synchronization challenges across mismatched sample rates and variable bus latencies, including firmware-level timestamping and diagnosing real dataset misalignment. - Firmware and embedded Linux experience: bringing up SoM/SBC platforms and debugging timing, interrupt, and buffer issues. - Strong mechanical engineering judgment: load paths, tolerance stack-up, strain relief, and real-world wearable ergonomics. - Proven ability to lead distributed teams across time zones and maintain engineering quality without daily in-person oversight. - Prior operating experience as a staff, principal, or founding engineer (not solely as an engineering manager). - Strong written communication skills and demonstrated ability to translate product needs into precise engineering briefs. Nice to have: - Supply chain and vendor management experience for hardware components. - Familiarity with regulatory compliance (UL/IEC) for wearable devices. - Experience with mass production handoff and manufacturing scale-up. Location This role is on-site in India, with regular travel to San Francisco, CA, USA (approximately one week per month). Candidates must already hold US citizenship or a valid US visa — visa sponsorship is not available. Compensation & Benefits - Salary: $140,000 – $210,000 USD annually - Opportunity to take on significant ownership and shape the engineering culture at a critical stage of growth in the wearable robotics space.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/head-of-engineering-clera

## About Truelogic At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals. Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference. By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future. ## Our Client This company is far more than a traditional real estate brokerage — it is a tech-powered media company reinventing how real estate is bought, sold, and experienced, combining elite sales talent, cutting-edge technology, and world-class content creation to build a completely new industry approach; its ecosystem spans luxury residential real estate, a powerful education platform, and an in-house creative agency, forming a vertically integrated model that is reshaping the real estate landscape, while offering engineers the opportunity to join an organization that treats technology as a core strategic differentiator, empowers small, autonomous, high-impact teams with full ownership, and values great design, clean code, and exceptional user experience, all within a company that is actively building the future of real estate. ## Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join a high-impact fintech-focused engineering team building resilient, scalable, and data-intensive systems. This role requires deep expertise across the full stack, from designing PostgreSQL schemas and distributed backend services to delivering polished React/Next.js user experiences. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who values reliability, operational excellence, and clean architecture, with experience handling complex financial workflows, asynchronous event processing, and high-stakes transactional data. You will work in a fast-paced environment with strong ownership, leveraging AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to deliver robust production-grade solutions. ## Responsibilities - Own the full lifecycle of product features, from database schema design and backend implementation to frontend delivery and production monitoring. - Design, build, and maintain scalable event-driven and distributed systems with strong guarantees around reliability and data consistency. - Develop and optimize complex PostgreSQL queries, migrations, and transactional workflows for high-performance financial operations. - Build resilient integrations with third-party systems using webhooks, queues, retry mechanisms, and reconciliation processes. - Implement reliability engineering patterns including idempotency, dead-letter queues (DLQs), outbox patterns, and fault-tolerant processing. - Create responsive and high-quality user interfaces using React and Next.js. - Contribute to architectural decisions and continuously improve system scalability, observability, and operational excellence. - Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar platforms to improve engineering productivity and accelerate delivery. - Participate in code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote best practices for handling sensitive financial and transactional data. - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering stakeholders to deliver exceptional user experiences. - Implement and maintain observability and monitoring solutions using tools such as Datadog or OpenTelemetry. - Contribute to infrastructure automation and cloud resource management using Infrastructure as Code practices such as Terraform or Pulumi. - Ensure engineering practices align with security, compliance, and regulated-environment requirements including SOC2 and PCI-DSS standards where applicable. ## Qualifications and Job Requirements - 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Engineer delivering production-ready applications end-to-end. - Strong proficiency with TypeScript and Node.js. - Advanced experience with React and Next.js. - Deep expertise in PostgreSQL and database engineering, including raw SQL, query optimization, migrations, and performance analysis. - Proven experience designing and maintaining event-driven and distributed systems. - Strong understanding of reliability engineering patterns, including: - Idempotency keys and retry strategies - Dead-letter queues (DLQs) - Outbox patterns - Reconciliation processes for data consistency - Experience building webhook-driven architectures and integrating third-party systems. - Solid understanding of scalable system architecture, asynchronous processing, and fault-tolerant applications. - Experience working with financial, payments, billing, payroll, or ledgering systems. - Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar agentic coding platforms. - Strong problem-solving skills with a systems-thinking mindset and attention to edge cases and data integrity. - Excellent communication skills and ability to work autonomously within high-impact engineering teams. - Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Pulumi. - Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog or OpenTelemetry. - Experience working in regulated or compliance-heavy environments, including SOC2 or PCI-DSS. - Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As a key player in our Analytics Engineering & BI team, you'll be at the forefront of how Power Digital designs, governs, and scales its Looker semantic layer. A critical part of your role will be owning the semantic layer modeling that powers every data product we ship, and making sure that layer serves multiple analytics surfaces including conversational analytics. You'll translate ambiguous stakeholder asks into flexible, durable models, ship best-in-class data products, and make sure every consumer of that model, human or AI, gets the right answer every time.

Responsibilities:

- Own and evolve Power Digital's enterprise LookML semantic layer as the governed foundation for analytics across our 1,000+ person organization and 600+ clients.
- Write scalable and performant LookML with rich metadata to support emerging conversational analytics use cases
- Translate ambiguous stakeholder and client asks into clear technical implementations, then design and optimize Looker assets that support scalable, reusable self-service analytics.
- Build best-in-class data products in Looker for internal stakeholders and clients, applying strong data visualization and UI/UX principles.
- Design LookML for scale and performance, partnering with Analytics Engineering on aggregate layer tuning and query optimization, and deploy and govern LookML across multiple Looker instances.
- Own the LookML style guide and naming conventions, train and support users adopting self-service analytics, and mentor junior developers and analysts.
- Employ AI technologies to maximize team leverage and efficiency.
- Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

  • 4+ years owning the full lifecycle of production-grade LookML models and data products
  • Advanced SQL proficiency with a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake and BigQuery preferred).
  • Strong foundation in dimensional modeling and data warehousing fundamentals.
  • Agency experience, including performance marketing analytics. Comfortable with the measurement, channels, and multi-client pace of a digital marketing agency serving multiple clients from eComm to B2B
  • Experience deploying and governing LookML across multiple Looker instances.
  • Experience with extensible LookML and modular visualizations in a multi-tenant environment
  • Experience mentoring and leveling-up the technical expertise of junior team members.
  • Experience with git-based version control and CI/CD workflows.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable with both engineers and executives.

Nice to have:

    • Experience routing LLM queries (directing natural-language questions to the right model/Explore.)
    • Conversational Analytics or comparable natural-language BI tooling experience.
    • Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools for accelerated LookML development
    • dbt or equivalent analytics engineering experience

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Reuse / leverage ratio: within the first 6 months, achieve >50% of client-facing reporting delivered from shared, governed semantic components (vs. bespoke client-specific LookML). Thereafter, maintain >= 75% quarter-over-quarter, measured from Looker content lineage
- Self-service deflection: within the first 6 months, increase the share of analytical questions resolved by users independently (Self-Service functionality or Omega) to 50% vs. adhoc requests from Asana and Slack. Thereafter, maintain >= 75%
- Source-of-truth integrity: hold production metric-definition discrepancies and data-quality incidents at < 5%, reconciled at each monthly close across Looker and downstream surfaces (Pacing Sheets, LLMs).
- User Experience: 95% of production data products load in 5 seconds or less, measured weekly
- Code quality: 95% style-guide and naming-convention conformance, measured monthly

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Establish and maintain the LookML style guide, naming conventions, and metric-definition source of truth the rest of the team builds against.
- Deliver the highest-priority Looker data products for active client and internal engagements on committed timelines.
- Build and ensure routing scalability of the field-level semantic metadata required for Conversational Analytics and AI-driven queries.
- Partner with Analytics Engineering to methodically tune diagnose and clear performance bottlenecks on production data products.
- Mentor and deputize junior developers through hands-on PR review and pairing on modeling and visualization work.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Reuse / leverage ratio: within the first 6 months, achieve >50% of client-facing reporting delivered from shared, governed semantic components (vs. bespoke client-specific LookML). Thereafter, maintain >= 75% quarter-over-quarter, measured from Looker content lineage
- Self-service deflection: within the first 6 months, increase the share of analytical questions resolved by users independently (Self-Service functionality or Omega) to 50% vs. adhoc requests from Asana and Slack. Thereafter, maintain >= 75%
- Source-of-truth integrity: hold production metric-definition discrepancies and data-quality incidents at < 5%, reconciled at each monthly close across Looker and downstream surfaces (Pacing Sheets, LLMs).
- User Experience: 95% of production data products load in 5 seconds or less, measured weekly
- Code quality: 95% style-guide and naming-convention conformance, measured monthly

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Establish and maintain the LookML style guide, naming conventions, and metric-definition source of truth the rest of the team builds against.
- Deliver the highest-priority Looker data products for active client and internal engagements on committed timelines.
- Build and ensure routing scalability of the field-level semantic metadata required for Conversational Analytics and AI-driven queries.
- Partner with Analytics Engineering to methodically tune diagnose and clear performance bottlenecks on production data products.
- Mentor and deputize junior developers through hands-on PR review and pairing on modeling and visualization work.

data.title: O&M Technical Coordinator (CAISO)
data.description:
Overview esVolta, LP is a leading developer, owner, and operator of utility-scale energy storage projects across North America. We are at the forefront of the fast-growing battery energy storage market, and our projects are helping to transition the nation’s electric grid to a cleaner and more reliable future. Our storage projects provide major utilities with a multitude of important services including reliable fast-ramping capacity, energy and ancillary grid services including renewable energy integration support. esVolta is independently owned, and we are among the largest players in the US energy storage sector with about 2.0 GWh of projects in operation or construction, and a 25+ GWh in the development pipeline. We are headquartered in Newport Beach, California, with employees in multiple regions across the U.S. Our diverse management team has many decades of experience in the renewable energy, utility, and independent power sectors. esVolta is an innovative industry leader in development, design, construction, financing, and management of utility scale energy storage projects. At esVolta, every employee makes an impact on the company’s growth and profitability, every day. We have a fast-paced, high-performance and team-oriented culture. We value quality of life and flexibility for our employees and strive to help our team members achieve their career goals. About The Role We are seeking individuals to join as O&M Technical Coordinator (CAISO) to support the operation, maintenance, reliability, and operational readiness of utility-scale battery energy storage system (BESS) assets operating within the CAISO market.The primary purpose of this role is to provide remote and on-site technical and operational support across assigned assets. The role supports troubleshooting, maintenance coordination, vendor management, warranty administration, commissioning activities, and operational readiness efforts to improve asset performance and availability. This position serves as a key extension of the O&M Manager and works closely with Asset Management, Operations Engineering, Field Operations, HSE, Compliance, OEMs, contractors, service providers, and Scheduling Coordinators supporting CAISO operations. This is not a primary site operator position; however, periodic travel to project sites is required to support troubleshooting, inspections, commissioning, testing, vendor oversight, corrective action verification, and other operational readiness activities. This position reports to the O&M Manager (CAISO), who retains management and oversight of our CAISO fleet of resources, including portfolio priorities, maintenance strategy, reliability performance, vendor management, and overall asset availability. The O&M Technical Coordinator serves as the primary execution and coordination resource supporting maintenance activities, technical issue resolution, documentation management, and field follow-through across assigned assets. This role interfaces regularly with Asset Management, Operations Engineering, Field Operations, Commercial Operations, HSE, Compliance, OEMs, contractors, service providers, and Scheduling Coordinators supporting CAISO operations. Core Responsibilities - Support day-to-day technical and operational activities across assigned CAISO battery energy storage assets. - Review alarms, fault logs, SCADA trends, EMS data, and service reports to support troubleshooting, issue resolution, and reliability improvement efforts. - Coordinate preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective maintenance (CM) activities, including vendor scheduling, work tracking, documentation management, and follow-through closure. - Support troubleshooting of utility-scale BESS equipment and plant systems, including battery systems, PCS equipment, EMS, SCADA, communications, and protection and controls systems. - Coordinate OEM, contractor, and service provider activities, including warranty administration, field service mobilization, corrective actions, and technical escalations. - Support CAISO operational readiness activities, including outage coordination, telemetry readiness, maintenance scheduling, and related operational documentation. - Maintain asset records, warranty logs, equipment histories, inventory tracking, RMAs, and other operational documentation within company systems. - Frequent travel to project sites as needed to support inspections, troubleshooting, commissioning activities, testing support, vendor oversight, and corrective action verification. - Support commissioning, turnover, and post-COD operational readiness activities to improve knowledge continuity and long-term asset performance. - Support internal reporting, compliance documentation, audit preparation, and continuous adherence to esVolta safety policies and procedures. Skills & Qualifications - 2-5 years of experience in utility-scale power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage, commissioning, field service, controls, SCADA, industrial electrical systems, or operations and maintenance is required. - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, operations, or related field is required. - Experience supporting assets operating within CAISO is required. - Experience supporting Powin-integrated utility-scale BESS platforms strongly preferred; familiarity with Dynapower PCS, EPC Power PCS, Sungrow PowerTitan 2.0, or comparable utility-scale energy storage technologies is a plus. - Familiarity with outage coordination, telemetry systems, SCADA communications, and utility-scale operational workflows. - Ability to read and interpret one-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, control schematics, and OEM technical documentation. - Experience supporting compliance documentation, audit preparation, and evidence retention practices. - OSHA 10/30, NFPA 70E, LOTO/JHA, or equivalent utility-scale safety training. - years of experience in utility-scale power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage, commissioning, field service, controls, SCADA, industrial electrical systems, or operations and maintenance. - Equivalent combinations of education, technical training, and relevant utility-scale, industrial, or military technical experience will be considered. - Experience supporting maintenance planning, maintenance execution, commissioning, field service, or technical operations activities. - Working knowledge of utility-scale BESS equipment and plant systems, including battery systems, PCS/inverter systems, transformers, switchgear, protection and controls, SCADA, EMS, and communications systems. - Experience reviewing alarms, fault logs, event histories, and operational data to support troubleshooting and issue resolution. - Experience working directly with OEMs, contractors, service providers, and cross-functional internal teams. - Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills, including the ability to manage multiple open issues and priorities simultaneously. - Experience with CMMS and asset management systems. - Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. - Valid driver's license is required. - Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Harvey) to improve efficiency, quality, and responsiveness of work, while applying sound judgment and appropriate oversight. Compensation, Location & Benefits The actual salary and bonus offered will depend on the specific skills and experience of the selected candidate. $120,00020% - 401(k) program with 6% match - Monthly cell phone stipend - Medical, dental and vision care benefits - 20 vacation days, 5 sick days and 9 observed holidays This position is classified as remotewithin the continental United States (international work is not permitted); however, periodic travel to company offices, project sites or other meeting locations may be required on an as-needed basis.Candidates based in California are strongly encouraged to apply - Willingness to travel to CAISO sites (estimated 30%) is required.esVolta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate all forms of diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. However you identify or whatever your path here, we encourage you to apply. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the hiring process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

data.title: Analog Design Engineer
data.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities. Tenstorrent is seeking an experienced Analog Design Engineer to develop cutting-edge die-to-die chiplet PHY IP solutions that power the future of AI computing. You'll work at the forefront of deep sub-micron technologies, collaborating with circuit architects and cross-functional teams to push the boundaries of analog/mixed-signal design. If you have a proven track record of delivering production-quality silicon and want to innovate at the heart of next-generation interconnects, join our team. This role is remote, based out of any in North America. We welcome candidates at various experience levels. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting. Who you are - A Analog/Mixed-Signal Design Engineer to develop die-to-die chiplet PHY IP, including PLLs and key analog/mixed-signal blocks in deep sub-micron FinFET technologies. - A hands-on owner for the full lifecycle: design, verification, layout interaction, tape-out, and silicon bring-up to production quality. - A strong cross-functional partner who can work with architecture, analog, digital, verification, layout, and software teams to integrate and optimize AMS IP. What we need - 10+ years of analog/mixed-signal IC design experience in FinFET, including PLL/AMS design, with an MSEE/PhD or equivalent background. - Strong track record in production tape-outs, silicon bring-up/testing, and hands-on use of industry-standard EDA tools with close layout collaboration. - Deep experience in high-speed datacomm/SerDes and die-to-die PHY design, including Tx/Rx, DDR, PCIe, and USB PHY components. - Collaborative, self-driven engineer with expertise across key circuits such as bias generators, amplifiers, LDOs, ADCs/DACs, oscillators, switched-cap circuits, plus familiarity with high-speed digital and equalization techniques like CTLE, DFE, and de-emphasis. What you will learn - How to push the limits of die-to-die chiplet PHY IP in advanced FinFET nodes, from architecture through high-volume production. - How to co-optimize analog, digital, and layout to hit aggressive performance, power, and area targets in complex SoCs. - Deeper expertise in high-speed I/O and PHY architectures, plus practical methodologies for scalable, reusable AMS IP across multiple products. Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made. Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer. This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.
